speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether the pricing policy of HDB's BTO flats remains the same in using the average mean income of each income group as a reference and not the prevailing market price; (b) what is the pricing policy for BTO flats in mature estates and whether there is a difference; and (c) whether there is a plan to address the pent up demand as a result of record sale prices crossing a million dollars in mature estates.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The EHG was introduced in September last year, with no restriction on the flat buyers' choice of flat type and location.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The vast majority of first-timer families are able to buy BTO flats in the non-mature estates and service their monthly mortgage instalments using CPF, with zero or minimal cash outlay.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Apart from BTO flats, some buyers also look to the resale market, where there is a wide range of flat choices.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Government will continue to monitor the housing market closely and ensure that Singaporeans have access to affordable public housing.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: The underlying concern is that because of the million-dollar transactions that we have seen recently, there is a concern that that might create anxiety.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: There might be a pent-up demand and as a result, anxiety.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Certainly, when there are these headline-grabbing articles which talk about HDB flats transacting at those prices, it may cause people to have the impression that overall there is a very, very high demand and that prices are escalating significantly.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But I have said, it is 0.3% of total resale transactions each year that are in that category.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: HDB, as I have said, continues to monitor closely housing affordability for both the BTO market as well as the resale market.
